fact: The ministry's May 2025 public portal manual describes applying for a title deed online through e-Ardhi: registering an account, entering plot and owner data, uploading documents, paying by control number and tracking progress.
title: Mwongozo wa Kuomba Huduma Kupitia Mfumo wa e-Ardhi (Public Portal), Toleo la Kwanza
publisher: Wizara ya Ardhi, Nyumba na Maendeleo ya Makazi
